@graph.name: Entry 27: re-baseline — São Paulo's gravity, bisect back in `bem`, and V8-exactness retired
@graph.text: A 0.24% reduction in gravity moves the assumed-parameter corpora and leaves the fitted ones alone. Longões: champion 3.6 → 3.5, canonical 5.1 → 5.2, off 19.3 → 19.1 med|Δ%|; censo: canonical 6.5 → 6.6, smooth ε=0.15 5.0 → 4.8, while the poor-man's ε=0.20 headline holds at 3.9. Every rider-corpus result is unchanged to four figures (P. Paz 4.9/+0.6 and the frozen-ε 0.091-vs-0.139 win; JAAM 3.5/+0.4; the author 6.1), as is the ε closed form (37% RMS skill, correlations 0.30/0.60/0.77/0.82, part–whole 0.72/0.99) and the time model's endpoint (T1b 6.6 vs T0 7.6). Direction as predicted: less gravity charges less for climbing, so over-predicting variants improve and the under-predicting canonical worsens. Conservation residual unchanged at 1.77e-8; cross-language parity unchanged at 8514 comparisons ≤ 1e-9.
